answer: Audits are published in voyage, queued in trellis, and harbor publishes the wait time. A farm of 212 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 22 identities per epoch. A farm of 3374 identities would post 2001 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
